main_text.p: rundam animas se esse fimul[?]abant: dolores increa-dibiles, quos in purgatorij flamma sustinerent, ex-ponentes. De poenarum carnificina queritantes, ab heredibus opem flebiliter, per suffragia, pre-ces meritorias, & missas mortuorum poftulabant. Atq; horum omnium actor erat diabolus. Et ut ad Ioannem reuertamur, ad otium conuerfus (ut ait Platina) nihil memoria dignum gefit. Paucis se rebus implicuit (inquit Crantzius) memor, quibus se priores difficultatibus innoluissent. Solummo-do suis commodis ac templorum quieti, ad volu-ptatem indulsit: & praeter dictas hydromantias nihil fecit. Post quatuor annos Satanici regiminis, anno Domini 1009. non fine veneni suspicione exspirauit.
main_text.head: §4. SERGIVS quartus.
main_text.p: Sergius quartus, patria & ipse Romanus, post horribilia haec, authore diabolo, perpetrata in ipso papatu facinora, Ioanni succedens, non aliis medius quàm sui praedecessores, pontificale consendit fastigium. A magna sanctitate, multisque virtutibus, cum tamen iuxta chronographos nihil egerit historia dignum, à suis commendatur. Ita solent adulatores papistae, nigros in albos vertere, ac fallaces operarios in lucis angelos transforma-re. Nec magnum est (inquit Apostolus) si Satanae minis[?]

page.notes: The first word "rundam" is a fragment from the previous page. "fimul[?]abant" is doubtful: the letter before "abant" is damaged. The word "Atq;" is printed with the abbreviation mark, kept as printed. The bottom-left marks "L 5" are read as a signature and the word at the right foot as a catchword, both doubtful. Long s is written as s throughout.
